description: This PHP script generates test execution results reports for the TestLink system, including HTML and XLS formats. It pulls test case metrics, constructs tables or spreadsheets, includes link generation for various actions, handles email sending, and manages user permissions and configurations.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class representing a rich, sortable, and groupable HTML table for displaying test results.

classes.name: tlHTMLTable
classes.description: A class representing an HTML table with customizable styling and layout for test result data.

methods.name: setSortByColumnName
methods.description: Sets the column name by which the table's data should be sorted.

methods.name: setGroupByColumnName
methods.description: Sets the column name by which the table should group its data.

methods.name: showToolbar
methods.description: Enables or disables the display of the toolbar for the table.

methods.name: toolbarExpandCollapseGroupsButton
methods.description: Enables or disables the expand/collapse groups button in the toolbar.

methods.name: toolbarShowAllColumnsButton
methods.description: Enables or disables the show all columns button in the toolbar.
